stories.headline: Tesla will stop building the Cybertruck in 2027
stories.summary: Tesla has said it will end production of its Cybertruck pickup in mid-2027. The factory space at Gigafactory Texas is to be used to build more of the Cybercab instead. News publications had already described the pickup as an automotive flop.

stories.headline: New Zealand's election ends too close to call
stories.summary: New Zealanders have elected 131 members to the House of Representatives under the mixed-member proportional system. The National Party took the most seats while Labour led the popular vote by a small margin, the first such split since 1981. Around 399,000 special votes are still to be counted, and official results are due on 27 November.

stories.headline: Europe's wild past was open country, not deep forest
stories.summary: Researchers led by Aarhus University have reconstructed what Europe's landscapes looked like long before farming, using fossilised pollen, charcoal left by ancient wildfires and chemical traces in animal teeth and bones. They found scattered trees, open woodlands, grassy clearings and wildflower meadows rather than closed forest, a mixture that lasted more than 20 million years. Large grazing animals helped to prevent trees and shrubs from taking over.
